"''Deep substrate foliated kalkite.|Director Krennic and the science officer|}} A '''science officer''' with the title of [[doctor]] was a [[human]] member of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Tarkin Initiative]], a secret research think tank for the [[Imperial Military]]. Involved with [[Project Celestial Power]], in [[4 BBY]], the [[Science officer]] was one of a handful of Imperials personally requested by [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] to join the [[Ghorman project]], an initiative by Krennic to extract vital [[kalkite]] from the surface of the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. Such a project would require [[gouge mining]], a [[mining]] process that would likely destabilize the planet's core, and as such, the population needed to be handled in methods created by the project. ==Biography== {{Quote|No notes. No records. None of you were here. Nobody puts this in their calendar. All service and transport droids will be data-wiped, once we're done. Your colleagues, superiors… if they're not in this room, they're not cleared for the project. Colonel Yularen, Governor Tarkin, all senior commanders will be notified by the Emperor, at the time of his choosing. Now, the group in this room is, of this moment, the tightest of closed circles. Any security violation will be brought to the Emperor's personal attention.|Orson Krennic instructs discretion to Daysar and the other attendees at the Maltheen Divide conference|}} [[File:TarkinInitiative.svg|thumb|left|300px|The doctor worked as a science officer for the Tarkin Initiative (logo, pictured)]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[doctor]] served as a [[Science officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Tarkin Initiative]], a secret think tank part of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]]'s [[Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research]]. As an employee of the Tarkin Initiative, the science officer was involved with [[Project Celestial Power]], which discovered the need for the [[mineral]] [[Kalkite]] in the [[Project Stardust|construction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. As such, in [[4 BBY]], the doctor, along with several other science officers from the Tarkin Initiative, was one of a handful of [[Imperial officer]]s who worked with [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research|Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] on the [[Ghorman project]], an initiative by Krennic to increase Imperial control over the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] in order to extract the need kalkite from it's surface, the [[mining]] of which was feared to destabilize the planet's core, and, as such, the planet's [[Ghorman (people)|population]] needed to be handled in methods created by the project. That same year, the science officer, along with other members of the Ghorman project, was summoned by Krennic to a [[Maltheen Divide conference|secret conference]] in the [[Maltheen Divide]] to discuss next steps for the removal of the Ghormans. There, the director explained the meeting's secrecy; there would be no records or notes, and any violation of security within the group would be brought to Palpatine's personal attention. Krennic then played to the room a [[Unidentified Ghorman holodocumentary|Ghorman Holodocumentary]] that detailed information about the planet, such as its [[Ghorman twill]] industry. Soon after, Krennic revealed the Empire's need for the planet's kalkite to the attendees of the meeting, and called upon the science officer to describe that Kalkite. As such, the science officer then explained that Ghorman had a unique variant of kalkite found underground in substrate foliated deposits. ==Equipment== The [[Science officer]] wore a dark and light gray [[Imperial scientist officer's uniform|Imperial science officer's uniform]] with a [[Tarkin Initiative]] insignia on each sleeve and single [[code cylinder]] on each [[breast]]. ==Behind the scenes== The officer debuted in "[[One Year Later]]," the premier episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. The officer was portrayed by actor [[Matthew Pidgeon]], and the episode released on [[April 22]], [[2025]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Officier scientifique non-identifié |ka=უცნობი სამეცნიერო ოფიცერი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Scientists]] [[Category:Tarkin Initiative personnel]]
